contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #305: Four-dimensional disk embedding and Wall's conjecture.

Resolve PD4 Lemma ct:upper-replacement under its original prepared height-eight input, with five retained stages, unchanged protected capped surfaces, arbitrarily many upper components, and sufficiently small entire upper-component direction images.

definitions.relative_input: Finite prepared framed Whitney-grope system satisfying ct:preparation; five lower stages and entire protected Clifford capped surfaces are fixed.
definitions.direction_control: The marking comparison and null-loop implication of ct:directions are granted input hypotheses, not established here.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 305 (Four-dimensional disk embedding and Wall's conjecture.; papers: A boundary-only obstruction to four-dimensional disk embedding; A marked tensor obstruction to four-dimensional disk embedding; A PD4 group without an aspherical manifold model; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

For every finite prepared Whitney-grope system of height at least eight satisfying ct:preparation and ct:directions, sufficiently small entire upper-component direction images, with a threshold depending only on the fixed finite coordinate cover of S, permit replacement above the first five stages by mutually disjoint framed immersed cap discs whose image loops are nullhomotopic in Z, while the retained stages and entire protected Clifford capped surfaces remain unchanged, independently of the number of upper components.

claims.natural_statement: For every metric space X, every index set I, every integer q>=1 and delta>0, let t=3^(q-1). If every set A_i retains an anchor a_i with a point y_i in K satisfying d(a_i,y_i)<delta, and d(x,a_i)<49t*delta for every x in A_i, then every point of the entire union of the A_i is within (49t+1)*delta<81t*delta=3^(q+3)*delta of K. If delta=epsilon/(162t), this union is in the epsilon/2-neighborhood of K, independently of I.

For any finite properly immersed union of framed disk-like capped gropes of height at least three, and a partition into q>=1 collections, the FQ Section 2.10.2 construction can be performed in an arbitrary relative neighborhood of the union. It retains original bodies, separates the collections with component-diameter growth at most 49*3^(q-1), then separates their members inside disjoint whole-collection neighborhoods. Final individual total contractions preserve the framed attaching regions and every closed protected set disjoint from that neighborhood.

For any finite properly immersed union of framed disk-like capped gropes of height at least three, and a partition into q>=1 collections, the FQ Section 2.10.2 construction can be performed in an arbitrary relative neighborhood of the union. Final individual total contractions preserve the framed attaching regions and every closed protected set disjoint from that neighborhood.

external_assumptions.statement: FQ defines contraction, contraction push-off, extension and height raising by operations in the framed grope model neighborhoods. Height raising changes caps, not original bodies; a disk-like grope totally contracts to an immersed disc with its given framed boundary. Two height-raising steps and q-1 push-offs in the compact-case separation proof bound component diameters by 49*3^(q-1).

external_assumptions.statement: Geometric duality of a capped surface to a capped grope means their entire images meet only in the prescribed bottom-stage point. Thus, for the supplied prepared input, every upper component misses the entire protected capped surface, not merely its body.
external_assumptions.source: Powell, Ray and Teichner, The 4-dimensional disc embedding theorem and dual spheres, versioned author preprint read after the publisher HTML endpoint returned HTTP 406.

claims.natural_statement: The specific group G constructed in the staged PD4 manuscript has a finite oriented four-dimensional aspherical Poincare complex Q and integral PD4 duality with trivial orientation action, but is not the fundamental group of any closed aspherical topological four-manifold (paper.tex, Theorem thm:main). This remains unverified.

The reflection and stabilization constructions of the staged PD4 manuscript produce the claimed finite oriented PD4 complex and, from a hypothetical closed aspherical manifold model, the marked periodic sphere systems and homotopies assumed at the start of control.tex. This setup is not certified by the upper-replacement audit.

For the specific marked boundary S->BH of the staged PD4 manuscript, no compact topological four-manifold with identified boundary S is homotopy equivalent to the finite graph BH by a homotopy equivalence extending the specified marking (Proposition ch:chamber, as summarized in paper.tex). This companion-obstruction input remains unverified here.

The compact peeled and filled manifold Z of control.tex admits interior surgeries producing a compact oriented topological four-manifold V with boundary S, fundamental group H, contractible universal cover, and original central boundary marking (Proposition ct:removal). This downstream statement is not verified by resolving upper replacement alone.

For each fixed height h, the outer projected sphere pairs in Y_R admit the uniformly bounded, label-preserving framed Whitney-grope preparation and full protected Clifford capped-surface duality asserted by ct:preparation, independently of R and without complementary fillings. This existence assertion remains unverified here; prepared input is a hypothesis of C_UPPER_REPLACEMENT.

The far-out direction map, including the prescribed extensions over peeled balls, has uniformly small entire bounded-propagation images and induces the central marking homomorphism to pi_1(Z), as asserted by ct:directions. Its construction and marking comparison remain unverified here and are supplied hypotheses of C_UPPER_REPLACEMENT.

For the specific Z and prepared systems in control.tex, the complement group comparison, post-null-loop tower construction with geometric duals, Lagrangian sphere surgeries, and regular-coefficient homology calculation have all hypotheses needed to deduce ct:removal from the upper replacements. This post-cap argument and the finite construction of Z remain unaudited here.
